title: Nabubulok

description: A former cameraman now works as a movie pirate operating in present day Manila. He routinely smuggles a digital camcorder into movie theaters in order to illegally record ﬁlms. One night he records something else and the footage goes viral.

title: Mangatyanan
description: Estranged photographer Laya ignores her ill father. Her long-absent mother urges reconciliation, but deeper wounds remain. Sent to document a vanishing tribe’s ritual, she confronts her own demons.

description: A man’s friends hire a prostitute on his birthday for him to lose his virginity. But after finding out that she is a middle-aged woman, they decide to ditch her, except for the birthday boy, who likes older women.
cast: Jaclyn Jose, Angelo Ilagan, Pierro Rodriguez, Alcris Galura, Miguel Iñigo Guño

title: Kargo
description: A woman relieves the heavy burden from her past when she finally exacts revenge on the man who murdered her entire family.
cast: Max Eigenmann, Jess Mendoza, Myles Robles, Ronnie Lazaro, Sunshine Teodoro

title: Vox Populi
description: San Cristobal mayoral candidate Connie de Gracia attends mass, hoping her piety wins votes—after all, the people’s voice is God’s. But Philippine politics isn’t so divinely blessed.
cast: Irma Adlawan, Bobby Andrews, Jim Libiran, Tony Mabesa, Gabe Mercado, LJ Moreno, Suzette Ranillo

title: Halaw
description: This research-based drama exposes human trafficking from Mindanao to Sabah. Diverse characters risk an illegal boat ride for a better life—despite the dangers and uncertain jobs in the “Promised Land.”
cast: John Arcilla, Arnalyn Ismael, Maria Isabel Lopez

title: Mudraks
description: In the silent Rabadon house, Margaret obsesses over order to avoid real problems and snoops on her family—until her daughter’s journal shatters her carefully unstirred life.

description: When an aborted baby is found in the dumpster of a small apartment complex, the lives of its tenants are turned upside down, and they are forced to confront the ghosts of their own past.

description: A boy's innocence is shattered when a TV news report reveals his father is a badly wounded soldier in Mindanao. As he and his mother wait for late rescue, the tragedy exposes how war's grim shadow impacts Filipino homes.
cast: Angeli Bayani, Paolo Constantino, Allen Dizon, Dexter Doria, Mark Fabillar, Sebastian Balde, Jaisene Bosito

title: Retirada
description: A retired government employee’s new hobby leads to existential desperation and financial complications.
cast: Peewee O'Hara, Jerry O'Hara, Donna Cariaga, Dexter Doria, Nanding Josef, Lui Manansala, Johanah Basanta
director: Milo Alto Paz and Cynthia Cruz-Paz

title: Isnats
description: A cellphone collector a.k.a. snatcher steals a drug dealer’s phone and the delivery that eventually leads into a confrontation with the syndicate’s angry boss who wants his money.
cast: Jourdan Sebastian, Joel Olano, Teddy Corpuz, Ida Ramos, Berting Labra, Archie Adamos, Maui Manalo, Ronald Tupas, Oz Mendoza, Vanessa Liwanag, Benjo Mariano, Bombi Plata, Sigfreid Barros-Sanchez, Lawrence Fajardo, Jobin Ballesteros

description: Four queer women in their 30s who are exes-turned-best-friends navigate adulthood, love, friendship, chosen families, and everything in between.
cast: Janella Salvador, Jasmine Curtis-Smith, Klea Pineda, Leanne Mamonong, Jackie Lou Blanco, Yesh Anne Burce, Migs Almendras, Rachel Coates, Jhoanna San Juan

title: Baryoke
description: Sexually frustrated Perla wants out of her marriage; servant Lea yearns for power; streetwalker Joan has a secret; and Diana is lost in grief. They find escape and salvation in the only place that inspires hope: the karaoke bar.
cast: Ronnie Lazaro, Pen Medina, Elizabeth Oropesa

title: ICU Bed #7
description: Lolo Joseph, the stubborn and loud-mouthed patriarch, whose illness tears his two daughters Cely and Beth to make a decision whether to end or prolong his life.
cast: Eddie Garcia, Angel Aquino, Noni Buencamino, Irma Adlawan

title: Room Boy
description: Luis, a motel roomboy, finds out the place where he is renting a room is about to be demolished. This sends him hunting for a new place to live with the help of Melba, a prostitute who is a regular client at the motel. Lonely and vulnerable, Luis starts falling for Melba. But giving into his emotions means abandoning his wife, Mercy, who is recuperating from a mental relapse in a mental institution.
cast: Polo Ravales, Meryll Soriano, Chanda Romero

title: Batad: Sa Paang Palay
description: While selling produce in the Banawe market to supplement his family’s income, a 14-year-old village boy starts dreaming of a life in the big city – and becomes obsessed with a pair of hiking boots that could take him there.

title: Donsol
description: Daniel, a whale shark interaction officer in Donsol, Sorsogon, falls in love with Teresa, a mysterious tourist carrying emotional scars of her own. As their relationship develops, they confront grief, healing, and the fragile beauty of life beneath and above the sea.
cast: Sid Lucero, Angel Aquino, Cherie Gil, Jaclyn Jose, Bembol Roco, Simon Ibarra, Kenneth Ocampo, Aarom Junatas, Erika Anne Luna, Mark Gil

title: Ang Huling Araw ng Linggo
description: Ang Huling Araw ng Linggo spans a week in a life of seven individuals with interconnected narratives.
cast: Johnny Delgado, Boots Anson-Roa, Jennifer Sevilla, Baron Geisler, Monica Llamas, Angeli Bayani, Arnold Reyes, Rodel Velayo, Madeleine Nicolas, Archi Andamos, Rolando Inocencio, Levi Ignacio, Carmen Sanchez, Dindo Martinez, Perry Dizon, Chunchi Cabasaan

title: In da Red Corner
description: Doring is a 24-year old girl who is engaged in a sport that is not common to Filipino women-boxing. This in her desire to alleviate her family from poverty which is slowly devouring them.
cast: Meryll Soriano, Aiza Marquez, Kathleen Hermosa, Grace Morales, Jojit Lorenzo, Mylah Ajero, Jason dela Cruz

title: Rotonda
description: Beginning at the break of dawn and ending the next morning, the story, set around a rugged city intersection, follows the path of a marked one-thousand-peso bill as it transfers from one character to another, returning to its originator in the end, blood-tainted. The money leads us to each of the five offbeat characters, all in desperate need of their soul’s redemption.
cast: Shamaine Buencamino, Celso Ad Castillo, Soliman Cruz, Michael Angelo Dagñalan, Mark Gil, Emilio Garcia, Epi Quizon, Meryll Soriano, Chona Fernando

title: Saan Nagtatago si Happiness?
description: A middle-aged man does everything he can to reunite with his mother, who he thought was dead.
cast: Andy Bais, Mica Torre, Caridad Sanchez, Ricky Davao, Rez Cortez, Nanette Inventor, Nonie Buencamino, Karla Pambid, January Isaac, Darling Laviña, Antonette Garcia, Ruth Alferez, Kenjie Villacorte, Elijah Castillo

title: Tulad ng Dati
description: A movie about the Filipino rock Band The Dawn.
cast: The Dawn(Jett Pangan, JB Leonor, Francis Reyes, Buddy Zabala, Carlos Balcells), Ping Medina, Agot Isidro, Mylene Dizon, Zoe Sandejas, Raffy Francisco, Nina Sandejas, Karl Roy, Buko Raymundo, Flip Corpus

title: Endo
description: Leo belongs to a poor family. Because he did not finish his studies, his only option is to work as a contractual worker in various establishments. In one job, he met a high-spirited girl named Tanya with whom he got romantically involved. In their relationship, he wishes to feel fulfillment and sense of security with her, but he is not prepared for this additional commitment.
cast: Jason Abalos, Ina Feleo, CJ Javarata, Ricky Davao, Alchris Galura

title: Gulong (The Bicycle)
description: Gulong is about friendship, love and life. The story is told from the point-of-view of Apao, a smart, kindhearted boy whose quest for an old bicycle reveals the stuff he is made of.
cast: Barbara Perez, Tricia Amper, Robert Arevalo, Jopet Concordia, Ina Feleo, Steven Fermo, Odette Khan, Gary Valenciano, Gardo Versoza

title: Kadin (The Goat)
description: Peping wakes up to find out that Gima, their goat, is missing. His family make a living out of the milk provided the goat. He hides the truth from his grandmother. His father is also arriving the next day so he needs to find Gima before its too late. Together with his younger sister, Lita, the two go on a seemingly impossible search for the goat in the landscape of the island of Sabtang, in Batanes.
cast: Rico Mark Cardona, Monica Joy Camarillas, Florencia Cardona, Ursula Gecha, Servilino Alavado

title: Ligaw Liham
description: When Nor learns the local post office has secretly ceased operations, he uses this as his chance to communicate with Karen, a longtime crush. Pretending to be Karen’s husband, who’s in Saigon, Nor writes love letters to the woman of his dreams.
cast: Karylle, Dingdong Dantes, John Michael Lee, George Macainan, Clarissa Deles

title: Pisay
description: The film, set in the 1980s, is centred upon a young student, from 1982 as a freshman and ending in 1986. The background is the last years of Martial Law in the Philippines where the Marcos dictatorship was at its peak.
cast: Elijah Castillo, Gammy Lopez, Annicka Dolonius, Carl John Barrameda, Shayne Fajutagana, Jonathan Neri, EJ Jallorina, Alfred Alain Labatos, Arnold Reyes, Wena Basco, Eugene Domingo, Glecy Atienza, Claudine Najera, Carina Evangelista, Rebecca Padilla, Ama Quiambao, Dra. Mary Raceles, Bernardo Bernardo

title: Still Life
description: The film, set in the 1980s, is centred upon a young student, from 1982 as a freshman and ending in 1986. The background is the last years of Martial Law in the Philippines where the Marcos dictatorship was at its peak.
cast: Ron Capinding, Glaiza de Castro, Irma Adlawan, Dimples Rimano, Alchris Galura, Joseph dela Cruz, Morny de Guzman

title: Tukso
description: The mysterious death of a young village lass leads to the investigation of those who knew her and what they may have to gain from her death. Told from the perspectives of the different characters, the film examines how one’s view may lead to varying interpretations of the same incidents.
cast: Irma Adlawan, Shamaine Buencamino, Soliman Cruz, Ricky Davao, Sid Lucero, Ping Medina, Diana Malahay, Nonie Buencamino, Mailes Kanapi, Ronnie Lazaro, Paolo O’Hara, Bing Pimentel, Tanghalang Pilipino Actors Company

description: With only three months left to live, a cancer patient compiles a list of tasks to complete before she dies.
cast: Mylene Dizon, Eugene Domingo, Tessie Tomas, TJ Trinidad, Ryan Eigenmann, Simon Ibarra, Cecile Paz

title: Boses
description: Boses (Voices) is the story of a musician named Ariel who offers violin lessons to a child of the slums. Through the violin, the abused child Onyok is able to get back his voice from a mute, desensitized existence. A violin teacher and his student, a mute 7-year old abused child in a shelter, develop a friendship stemming from their love of music.
cast: Coke Bolipata, Julian Duque, Ricky Davao, Meryll Soriano, Tala Santos, Cherry Pie Picache

title: Brutus
description: Shot in Oriental Mindoro, Philippines, Brutus follows two kids smuggling logs from the mountains. It is about the journey that opens their eyes to a ‘world’ that is ruled by greed and torn by the political conflicts.
cast: Ronnie Lazaro, Yul Servo, Timothy Castllo, Rhea Medina

title: Concerto
description: Concerto is about how, in the last part of World War II, a special piano concert is held in the forest outside Davao City, in Mindanao.
cast: Jay Aquitania, Meryll Soriano, Shamaine Buencamino, Nonoy Froilan, Elijah Castillo, Alyssa Lescano

title: My Fake American Accent
description: A slice-of-life workplace comedy following the lives of technical support call center agents in the span of six months. Speaking with a fake American accent is a prerequisite for the job. This ensemble comedy is an inside look into the maddening, sleep-deprived, caffeine-fuelled lives of those who ply their trade in the call center industry.
cast: Mailes Kanapi, Jonathan Neri, Martin dela Paz, Cherry Mae Canton, Miro Valera, Tracy Abad, Maan Asuncion, Bidz de Leon, Vince de Jose, Jose Esguerra, Cenon Palamores

title: Namets!
description: Follows the flirtation between Manuel and Lourdes, two Negrosanon whose lives revolve around food. Along the way, we are treated to the full panorama of Negrosanon cuisine and the idiosyncrasies of Negrosanon eating.
cast: Christian Vasquez, Angel Jacob, Peque Gallaga, Dwight Gaston, Monsour Del Rosario, JM Rodriguez, John Arceo, Joel Torre, Ronnie Lazaro

title: Ranchero
description: Ranchero unfolds in a small provincial jail in Rizal. It’s about Ricardo whose last day in jail is today. He and his close friend Miyong work in the jail’s kitchen. The two spent the whole morning talking about Ricardo’s plans when he gets out of jail.

title: 24K
description: Manok is a middle-class treasure hunter who’s been digging for Japanese treasure for years. He and his companions are in the final stage of their current site in the mountains of Suyo, Ilocos Sur, an area reputed as a Japanese stronghold during World War II.
cast: Julio Diaz, Archi Adamos, Jojit Lorenzo, Archristian Galura, Miguel Vasquez, Andoy Ranay

title: Colorum
description: After spending thirty years in prison, Pedro (Lou Veloso), aging and obviously clueless as to what has become of the world outside the penitentiary, is finally freed.
cast: Lou Veloso, Alfred Vargas, Archie Adamos, Jose Mari Avellana

title: Dinig Sana Kita (If I Knew What You Said)
description: Deaf dancing boy meets troubled rocker chick in a Baguio camp for Deaf and hearing kids where find that they have more in common with each other including a love for music.
cast: Lou Veloso, Alfred Vargas, Archie Adamos, Jose Mari Avellana

title: Engkwentro
description: Two teenage brothers are attempting to escape an unnamed city controlled by an iron-fisted mayor. They must first break away from the cycle of crime, while trying to run from rival gang leaders and the state’s murderous vigilantes.
cast: Felix Roco, Daniel Medrana, Eda Nolan, Zyrus Desamprado, Bayang Barrios, Celso Ad Castillo

title: Last Supper No. 3
description: Assistant Production Designer Wilson Nañawa is tasked to look for a Last Supper to use as a prop for a TV commercial. He finds three, but loses the one owned by Gareth Pugeda.
cast: Joey Paras, Jojit Lorenzo, JM de Guzman, Beverly Salviejo, Debraliz Valesote, Dante Balois, Ness Roque, Andoy Ranay, Cecile Torre, Marlon Hofer, Rommel Luna, Malou Crisologo, Mark Meily, Bernard Laxa, Maricel Soriano, Alex Tiglao, Gina Lumauig, Kalila Aguilos, Jason Moss, Rita Iringan, Liza Lorena, Ronli Vergel de Dios, Ricky Davao

title: Ang Nerseri
description: Cocoy, 12, takes on a great responsibility of taking care of his older siblings while his mother, Mai, goes to the province to get money to pay the expensive hospital bills for her three mentally sick children.
cast: Timothy Mabalot, Jaclyn Jose, Lance Raymundo, Alwyn Uytingco, Claudia Enriquez, Ynes Veneracion, Tony Mabesa

title: Sanglaan (The Pawnshop)
description: Follows the lives of four different people, each linked to the other by the house of business.
cast: Tessie Tomas, Ina Feleo, Joem Bascon, Neil Carme Sanchez, Mica Torre, Karla Pambid, Giovanni Baldesseri

title: Astig
description: Four men, four stories, all intersect in Manila. Episode one is about Ariel, a con-man. Episode two is about Boy, an expectant father. In the third episode, Ronald goes to Manila to sell a building. And in the fourth story Baste saves his sister from Ariel.
cast: Dennis Trillo, Sid Lucero, Arnold Reyes, Edgar Allan Guzman, Glaiza De Castro

title: Donor
description: Desperate for money, Lizette pursues the dark and thankless world of organ donation, hoping for a better life.
cast: Baron Geisler, Meryll Soriano, Jao Mapa, Karla Pambid, Lilit Reyes, Kristina Syfu, Joy Viado

title: Sigwa
description: A former student activist returns to the Philippines to find the daughter she was forced to leave behind.
cast: Marvin Agustin, Gina Alajar, Jay Aquitania, Rico Barrera, Tirso Cruz III, Allen Dizon, Marili Fernandez-Ilagan, Dessa Rizalina, Fernandez Ilagan, Pauleen Luna, ZsaZsa Padilla, Jim Pebanco, Lovi Poe, Raquel Villavicencio, Megan Young, Dawn Zulueta

title: The Leaving
description: The Leaving explores the constant cycle of change, departure, and return through the lives of a new generation of Tsinoys (Filipino-Chinese). Set in a neo-Chinatown in Manila, the film follows three interconnected stories that portray their struggles with identity, relationships, and the fading of their cultural heritage.
cast: Acey Aguilar, Margery Lao, Miaka Lao, LJ Moreno, Gary Lim, Arnold Reyes, Fonz Desa, Menchu Sintay, Ronnie Martinez, Mark Lloyd Lao

title: Magkakapatid (Blood Ties)
description: Magkakapatid is a story about a family that drifts apart due to socio-economic differences. Three siblings, three narratives, one tragedy, wherein a brother kills his own brother, a father struggles to accept a daughter’s marriage, and a daughter who could not mourn.
cast: Julio Diaz, Ces Quesada, Raquel Villavicencio, Shamaine Buencamino, Nico Antonio, Banaue Miclat, Archie Adamos, Soliman Cruz, Mercedes Cabral, Jerald Napoles, Kathlyn Castillo, Rommel Acosta, Mash Mojica

title: Rekrut
description: Jamir, a devout Muslim, and Lando, a Christian, are among an elite group of young recruits formed by military officers for a classified operation. These impressionable young men would undergo intense and grueling training that put their will and strength of character to the test.
cast: Emilio Garcia, Joem Bascon, JM De Guzman, Alwyn Uytingco, Dominic Roco, Alchris Galura, CJ Ramos, Manuel Chua Jr., Archi Adamos, Rob Sy

title: Sampaguita, National Flower
description: This film tells the story of a group of children whose lives are inexorably bound up with Sampaguita the national flower of Philippines and the myths that surround it. Sampaguita blossoms are much sought-after but, since they wilt quickly, they must be sold within twenty-four hours. All the children in this film are are all sampaguita pickers or sellers.
cast: Marlon Abalos, Maya Bernardo, Reynalyn Bunag, Karla Pambid, Ronalyn Ramos

title: Si Techie, Si Teknoboy at Si Juana B.
description: Techie and Jay, both OFWs from Qatar, decide to come home for two weeks to get married. Unknown to Jay, Techie is nurturing a plan to meet her virtual lover, Teknoboy, before her wedding day.
cast: Danilo Barrios, Mercedes Cabral, Rizza Calderon, Auriette Divina, Karen Divina, Dencio Isungga, Mark Jacob, Leo Lim, Lester Llansang, J.C. Parker, Rafael Rosell, Riza Rubio, Christian Vasquez, Joy Viado, Arvy Cesar Viduya

title: Busong
description: Punay was born with wounds on her feet so that she cannot step on the earth. Her brother, Angkarang, carries her through a hammock, as he searches the changing landscape of Palawan in hoping to find a healer who can cure Punay. Different people help him carry his sister along the way- a woman looking for her husband, a fisherman who lost his boat, and a young man who is searching for himself- and each one meets their fate.
cast: Alessandra de Rossi, Dax Alejandro, Clifford Banagale

title: Ang Babae sa Septic Tank
description: Cynical filmmakers plan on producing a bleak, independent film dealing with poverty and prostitution in the hopes of scoring free travel to international film festivals.
cast: Eugene Domingo, JM De Guzman, Kean Cipriano, Cai Cortez, Mercedes Cabral, Cherry Pie Picache

title: Bahay Bata (Baby Factory)
description: Sarah is a nurse at a Public Maternity Hospital. The hospital is abuzz with pregnant mothers of all shapes and sizes in different stages of labor. The hospital is short on staff on Christmas Day so Sarah is forced to put in a double shift. Sarah observes the women coming and going in her ward, noting who is a first-timer and who is a veteran.
cast: Eugene Domingo, JM De Guzman, Kean Cipriano, Cai Cortez, Mercedes Cabral, Cherry Pie Picache

title: Cuchera
description: Based on a true story, Cuchera is about Filipino drug mules, drug couriers and their recruiters. It follows the story of Isabel, a veteran drug mule, in her first attempt at running her own drug transshipment operation between Manila and China.
cast: Maria Isabel Lopez, Simon Ibarra, CJ Ramos, Paolo Rivero, Jon Neri, Sue Prado, Isadora, Kimmy Fajardo

title: I-Libings
description: A coming of age story about Isabel’s lessons and realizations on life and death as a funeral videography intern.
cast: Glaiza de Castro, Rez Cortez, Louella De Cordova, Marc Abaya, Carlo Aquino, Alchris Galura, Earl Ignacio, Dexter Doria, Osan Reodica, GA Villafuerte, Valkent Darunday, Gege Severo, Betty Uy Regala, Enzo, Maecon Timbol

title: Ligo na Ü, Lapit na Me
description: College senior Intoy (Edgar Allan Guzman) is unwittingly fallen into a friend-with-benefits situation with his mysterious classmate Jenny (Mercedes Cabral). Jenny has a reputation for being promiscuous, and Intoy plays aloof to hide the fact that he’s fallen in love with her.
cast: Edgar Allan Guzman, Mercedes Cabral, Mel Kimura, Simon Ibarra, Tolyts “Shalala” Reyes, Evelyn Vargas, Beverly Salviejo, Malou Crisologo, Jojo Saguin, Joseph Bitangcol, Lucky Mark Mercado, Joe Vargas, Christian Tan, Ian Lazibal, Alex Tiglao, Ardie Bascara, Victor Medina, Luis Alandy

title: Niño
description: The once-prominent Lopez-Aranda family is falling apart as Celia, a former opera star, struggles with debt and the threat of losing her home while caring for her bedridden ex-husband, Gaspar. When Gaspar falls into a coma and his daughter Raquel returns from the US to sell the house, Celia turns to her faith in the Sto. Niño and hopes for a miracle to save her from homelessness.
cast: Fides Cuyugan Asensio, Shamaine Buencamino, Tony Mabesa, Raquel Villavicencio, Art Acuna, Diana Malahay, Joaquin Valdes, Jhizhelei Deocareza

title: Teoriya
description: Teoriya is a story about loss that centers on the film’s main character, Jimmuel Apostol II. After hearing the news that his father has passed away, Jim goes back home to Zamboanga City after leaving ten years ago in bad terms with his father. He arrives in Zamboanga only to find that his father has already been buried and he doesn’t know where.
cast: Alfred Vargas, Sue Prado

title: Rookie
description: Everything changes when an awkward teenager joins the volleyball team and falls for the volleyball team captain.
cast: Pat Tingjuy, Aya Fernandez, Agot Isidro

title: Kalayaan (Wildlife)
description: Julian, a soldier stationed on a remote Philippine island, is forced to extend his stay after news of a coup d’état in Manila reaches his base. When he loses contact with the main base and begins sensing someone watching him, two soldiers arrive to investigate and recount the strange story of a former soldier who claimed to have encountered a mermaid.
cast: Ananda Everingham, Zanjoe Marudo, Luis Alandy, Rocky Salumbides, Kiki Sugino, Angeli Bayani

title: Kamera Obskura
description: The narrative plays with the idea of a retro-futurist world where a prisoner locked away in a dark chamber for over two decades only sees the reality of the world outside through the small hole in his cell, which projects an image of the city on his wall.
cast: Pen Medina, Joel Torre, Nanding Josef, Abe Pagtama, Irene Gabriel, Ping Medina, Suzette Ranillo, Lou Veloso, Archie Adamos, Madeleine Nicolas, Sue Prado, Ces Aldaba, Teddy Co

title: The Animals
description: Set in an affluent, upper middle class village in the suburbs, “The Animals” chronicles a day in the life of Jake, Trina, and Alex, who go through the musings that every kid in high school has to deal with.
cast: Albie Casiño, Dawn Jimenez, Patrick Sugui, John Wayne Sace, Bryan Homecillo, Vangie Martelle, Micah Cabral, Issa Litton, Raul Morit, Evangeline Torcino, Giovanni Baldisseri, Carlo Cruz, Andrew Felix

title: Mga Dayo
description: Set in Guam on Thanksgiving Day, the film follows three Filipina immigrants whose lives intersect as they struggle with marriage, relationships, family, and belonging. Alex, Miriam, and Ella each face difficult choices that force them to question where they truly consider home.
cast: Sue Prado, Janela Buhain, Olga Natividad, Brandon Muna, Brian Muna, Charlene Baes Leffler, Louella Camaganacan, Aaron Agsalud, Vicky Flor, Vicky Dizon, Ron Pangan

title: Intoy Syokoy ng Kalye Marino
description: Intoy Syokoy ng Kalye Marino follows Intoy, a mussel caretaker in Cavite City who dreams of building a stable life with Doray, a sex worker he has loved since childhood. As both struggle with poverty and the lasting effects of the former American naval base, Intoy’s hopes for love and livelihood are threatened by an unexpected turn of nature.
cast: JM de Guzman, LJ Reyes, Joross Gamboa

title: Ang Katiwala (The Caretaker)
description: Ruben, a carpenter who loses his job in Zambales, moves to Quezon City to work as a caretaker of an abandoned house. After discovering that the former owner was an important historical figure, Ruben becomes fascinated by his life and begins to idolize him.
cast: Dennis Trillo, Ronnie Lazaro, Angelina Canapi, Althea Vega, Miggs Cuaderno, Neri Naig, Ernie Zarate, Shyr Valdez, Richard Manabat, Louella de Cordova, Aileen Lota, Dado Jose

title: Ang Nawawala (What Isn't There)
description: Gibson Bonifacio, a 20-year-old who stopped speaking as a child, returns to Manila after three years abroad and finds his family still struggling with a painful loss. As he reconnects with his childhood best friend and discovers a possible first romance, Gibson begins to confront his past and redefine his relationships with his family, friends, and himself.
cast: Dominic Roco, Annicka Dolonius, Dawn Zulueta, Felix Roco, Boboy Garrovillo, Alcris Galura, Mercedes Cabral, Kelvin Yu, Jenny Jamora, Marc Abaya, Sabrina Man

title: Oros
description: A funeral parlor owner sells an unidentified body to Makoy, who stages a three-week wake with his reluctant brother Abet to run an illegal gambling den. As they create a fictional story to legitimize the wake, they become entangled with the desperate people who depend on its profits.
cast: Kristoffer King, Kristoffer Martin, Tanya Gomez, Kim Komatsu, Diva Montelaba, Angelita Raymundo

title: REquieme!
description: The film follows Swanie, a barangay chair who stages a wake for her infamous relative to gain political favor, while her estranged transgender son Joanna struggles in Manila to give a neighbor a proper burial. As mother and son deal with separate deaths, they are forced to confront the grief and wounds they have long kept buried.
